quest.title: Doctor's Orders
quest.description: Zakariya of Bimarstan is taking great pains to help his patients.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a headache...

choices.text: Do you need a hand with anything?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: We have been really shorthanded lately, and I haven't slept for days on end.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: If you would, Traveler, could you help me deliver some medicine to the patients nearby? Please check on them as well.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: I'm counting on you. For the Dendro Archon's sake, I could really use a helper capable of saying something other than saying "Dendro Archon bless you."

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Hah, "For the Dendro Archon's sake"... I've been saying that a lot lately, haven't I?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: I'm afraid I simply cannot. I have placed patients with more serious conditions elsewhere, and I have to prepare medicines for them.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: *sigh* They will definitely ask me how they might embrace the blessings of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: I am counting on you. I could really use an assistant capable of something other than talking about the blessings of the Dendro Archon...

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: You must be a traveler. This is Bimarstan, a hospital that aids the masses... Um... by spreading the blessings of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: No matter rich or poor, anyone in need shall get medical help here.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: But as a result... We have too many patients and not enough hands to see to them all.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: *sigh* The benevolence of the Dendro Archon might be endless... But our budget and manpower are not.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: And then there are patients who ignore all medical instructions, but just keep asking about how to better embrace the blessings of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Haha, blessings of the Dendro Archon... My goodness!

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: If the Dendro Archon really could just rain down blessings, they wouldn't have gotten sick in the first place!

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: ...Phew, sorry, I shouldn't have said that. Please don't tell Golshan about this, or she might lecture me again.

choices.text: Aren't you a pious believer of the Dendro Archon?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Of course I am. Can you find someone in Sumeru City who isn't?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: But you can leave "piousness" out of this. I would consider myself a rather... rational believer in the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Ugh... Sorry, I must be too tired out. I was just venting. Please don't take what I said too seriously.

choices.text: Some say that treatment itself is the blessing of the Dendro Archon...

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: *sigh* But just consider these stories, alright? Don't be so serious about it like some of our patients.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: If the Dendro Archon were as mighty as the legends claim, I would only need to feed people some mushrooms, and bam, they would be healed.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: The medicine delivery this time is for Gurgen, who is at the medicine farm.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: He strained his arm from doing too much work a few days before.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Please give him this medicine. By the way, tell him to also stay at home and pray silently to the Dendro Archon. Farm work can wait.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Please come back once the delivery is done. I will have the payment ready for you.

choices.text: Pray silently to the Dendro Archon?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: He won't listen to a word I say if I don't say that. Just do as I instructed, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Huh? This is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's your medicine, remember to pray quietly to the Dendro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Ah, thanks. Pray quietly to the Dendro Archon... Yes, I must do that...

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: But there are so many <color=#00E1FFFF>weeds in the field</color>... If I keep doing nothing, it's going to affect the yield.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Um... I'll just <color=#00E1FFFF>deal with the weeds</color> first, then do my silent prayers when I finish.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: You're back. How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He wanted to deal with the weeds first...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: *sigh* So even the silent prayer line didn't work... I suppose I'll have to come up with something else.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Thanks for your hard work. Please, take this as payment.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: The weeds... You've removed them all? I... You're too kind!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just go back home and rest.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I will, thank you. May the Dendro Archon bless and protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I should hurry home to conduct my silent prayers to the Dendro Archon as well.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: You are back. How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About removing the weeds...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Ah, that's great. This way, Gurgen can finally have some proper rest. He should be able to recover sooner.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: The medicine this time is for Azra at the theater entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: She has been coughing lately, but she refused to take the medicine I prescribed, saying that it tastes too bitter.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Please give her this medicine. Also, tell her that... Um...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: This... bitterness in the medicine is but a... test, yes, a test, bestowed by the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Please come back once the delivery is done. I will have the payment ready for you.

choices.text: Where did you learn this stuff?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: I didn't exactly learn it? I've just heard these kinds of things too often.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: *sigh* I guess my body isn't what it used to be... No, I can't give up yet. I must persist for a while more.

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Hmm... This smells familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's your medicine. Remember to finish all of it...

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Ugh, this <color=#00E1FFFF>super bitter medicine</color> again. I can't take it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is but a test from the Dendro Archon, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that so? But <color=#00E1FFFF>it's so bitter</color>... Can't the Dendro Archon be just a wee bit nicer?

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: ...Alright, alright, hand me the medicine. I'll take it later...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: You're back. How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She complained that the medicine was too bitter.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Well, there's nothing I can do about that. After all, the nature and components of the herbs... Ahem, I mean blessings, come with some bitterness.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Hopefully, she will finish it all this time. There was so much left over previously...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Thanks for your hard work. Please take this as payment.

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Eh? Are these for me? Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Alright! I'll give the medicine another go... I'll finish it all for sure this time!

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: You're back. How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I gave her some candies.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Candies? They'll reduce the efficacy of that medicine, though.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: ...Ah, never mind. Reduced efficacy is better than no efficacy at all, and at least she can finish the medicine this time around.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: I really can't thank you enough. Please take this as payment.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: The medicine delivery this time is for Aftab at the farmhouse.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: That fellow's been living on a greasy diet, so he has serious digestion problems.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: So please give him this medicine. By the way, tell him that... Um...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Tell him that eating lighter foods and having less alcohol and meat is the way to better embrace the blessings of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Please come back once the delivery is done. I will have the payment ready for you.

choices.text: Where on earth did you hear such things?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Some Akademiya researchers have said that we can do something like that, though I don't understand why...

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: I just need to hold on for several days more...

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is this medicine?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's your medicine. Please maintain a light diet.

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: *sigh* Okay, I will. Honestly, I <color=#00E1FFFF>haven't touched a slice of meat</color> in days. I'm sure that this will definitely help me to embrace the Dendro Archon's blessings better...

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: But why do I feel worse than before? *sigh* No, no, I must've just spent too little time dieting, that's all...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: You're back. How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He has kept away from meat for quite a few days now...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: What? I was telling him to eat lighter, not to completely stop eating meat!

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Does he think that he can best embrace the Dendro Archon's blessings this way?

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Alright... I guess I have to come up with something else...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Thanks for your hard work. Here, this is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: What is this? No... The scent is just too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So here's what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: Really? A light diet doesn't mean a full ban on meat? Even the Akademiya researchers don't do that?

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: S—So that's it! I was afraid of making the Dendro Archon angry by eating meat.

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: If even the researchers do eat meat... I won't worry about eating meat anymore. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: You're back. How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I told him that he could just eat a steak or two...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Oh? It didn't occur to me you could put it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Well, as long as Aftab is treating his body right, everything should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is too bitter for anyone to swallow. How am I supposed to take it all?

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: If I stop tending to the field for too many days, the weeds are going to grow...

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: *sigh* Day after day, I guard this door. When will I get to take a look inside?

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: I just need to hold on for a few days more...
